description: Two flip-flops on one clock: a toggle that flips on every gate, and a data latch that samples a second input

inputs.text: A rising gate here flips the toggle outputs and makes the data outputs sample In D
Sampled whenever In T rises; 1V or more latches the data output on, below that turns it off

outputs.text: Flips between 10V and 0V on each rising gate at In T, dividing that clock by two
10V when In D was at 1V or more on the last rising gate at In T, 0V when it was below
The opposite state of the FFT output, 0V whenever FFT is at 10V
The opposite state of the FFD output, 0V whenever FFD is at 10V
